patthana9.16:1.1: na saraṇaṃ na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana9.16:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.16:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasaraṇaduka naupādinnupādāniyattikaṃ
patthana9.16:6.1: na saraṇaṃ na upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.16:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.16:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca …. pe. na saraṇaduka nasanidassanattikaṃ
